en.headline: Victoria Park Mid-Autumn lantern carnival opens with international displays
en.dek: The LCSD carnival and the Tourism Board’s first International Lantern Spectacular run from 17 to 27 September, featuring thousands of lanterns including an eight-metre banyan installation.

zh.headline: 維園中秋綵燈會開幕 首辦國際綵燈匯展出逾三千盞燈
zh.dek: 康文署綵燈會及旅發局國際中秋綵燈匯由9月17日至27日舉行，亮點包括八米高榕樹綵燈及港式美食造型燈飾。

en.headline: 999 callers to send real-time audio and video from 2028, Tang says
en.dek: Security minister Chris Tang outlined three new functions for the emergency hotline, including instant multimedia transfer to Fire Services and call prioritisation in major incidents.

zh.headline: 鄧炳強：999熱線2028年增實時傳影音功能
zh.dek: 保安局局長表示將新增三項功能，包括市民用通訊軟件即時傳送聲影畫、資料即時轉交消防，以及繁忙時優先處理危急個案。

en.headline: Police officer left paralysed in 2005 knife attack dies after 21 years
en.dek: Constable Chu Chun-kwok, awarded the Medal for Bravery (Gold) for chasing an armed attacker despite a severed artery, died on Wednesday at the age of 52.

zh.headline: 2005年執勤被斬頸癱瘓21年 警員朱振國離世
zh.dek: 朱振國周三於廣華醫院逝世，終年52歲。他曾獲頒金英勇勳章，表揚在頸動脈被割斷下仍追截持刀兇徒。

en.headline: Basketballer Yang and wushu athlete Sham named Asian Games flag bearers
en.dek: Ivan Yang and Lydia Sham will lead the Hong Kong, China contingent into the opening ceremony in Nagoya on Saturday, the Sports Federation and Olympic Committee announced.

zh.headline: 亞運持旗手公布 楊博文沈曉榆領軍開幕
zh.dek: 籃球員楊博文及武術運動員沈曉榆獲選為香港代表團亞運開幕禮持旗手，體育總會周四在名古屋歡迎禮上宣布。

en.headline: MTR to extend services about 1.5 hours over Mid-Autumn Festival
en.dek: Local lines and Light Rail will run later on 25 September, with denser frequencies from mid-afternoon, while East Rail Line strengthens weekend services and high-speed rail adds trains.

zh.headline: 港鐵中秋延長服務約1.5小時 多綫加密班次
zh.dek: 中秋節當日本地綫及輕鐵延長至凌晨一至二時許收車，下午三時起逐步加密至約兩分鐘一班，東鐵綫周末亦加強服務。

en.headline: Worker falls three metres from water tank at Tai Kok Tsui estate
en.dek: A 60-year-old man was found unconscious after an apparent fall during maintenance work at Imperial Cullinan on Hoi Fai Road; police are treating it as an industrial accident.

zh.headline: 大角咀帝匯豪庭維修工人墮水箱三米昏迷
zh.dek: 60歲男工人周四傍晚在海輝道私人屋苑進行維修時疑由約三米高水箱墮下，昏迷送院，警方列工業意外調查。

en.headline: First local chikungunya case of 2026 confirmed in Tai Kok Tsui
en.dek: A 55-year-old woman living on Li Tak Street has tested positive; she had no recent travel history and is in stable condition in a mosquito-free ward.

zh.headline: 本港今年首宗基孔肯雅熱本地個案 患者居大角咀利得街
zh.dek: 55歲女子無外遊紀錄，目前情況穩定，正於伊利沙伯醫院無蚊環境下接受治療。

en.headline: Jobless rate rises to 3.8pc in June-August period
en.dek: Seasonally adjusted unemployment edged up 0.1 percentage point from the previous three months, while underemployment climbed to 1.9 per cent, Census and Statistics Department figures show.

zh.headline: 六月至八月失業率升至3.8% 就業不足率1.9%
zh.dek: 經季節性調整失業率較前三個月上升0.1個百分點，就業不足率亦升至1.9%，統計處公布最新勞動人口數字。

en.headline: Hang Seng closes down about 159 points after Fed and HKMA rate rises
en.dek: The benchmark index finished Thursday at 24,554.50, off 0.64 per cent, as investors digested the first US rate increase since 2023 and the matching Base Rate lift.

zh.headline: 恒指收市跌約159點 市場消化美息及基本利率上調
zh.dek: 恒生指數周四收報24,554.50點，跌159.28點或0.64%，投資者消化聯儲局加息及金管局同步上調基本利率至4.25厘。

en.headline: Tesla driver jailed 22 months for fatal amber-light crash in Yuen Long
en.dek: District Court sentences Ernest Au Yeung to 22 months and five years’ disqualification after he accelerated through an amber light and killed a 19-year-old pedestrian in 2024.

zh.headline: 元朗衝黃燈撞斃少女 Tesla司機判囚22個月停牌5年
zh.dek: 區域法院周四判處承認危險駕駛引致他人死亡的歐陽劭匡監禁22個月及停牌5年，指其駕駛態度極之危險。

en.headline: Government opens 26 hectares at Hung Shui Kiu for university campuses
en.dek: Three plots in the Northern Metropolis university town are open for post-secondary institutions to apply until 31 December, with results expected early next year.

zh.headline: 政府推出洪水橋大學城三幅用地 院校申請年底截止
zh.dek: 北都洪水橋大學城共約26公頃校園區用地今日開放申請，合資格專上院校可至12月31日遞交建議，預計明年初公布進駐院校。

en.headline: Three-alarm fire breaks out at Lau Fau Shan wood warehouse
en.dek: Fire Services upgraded the blaze at a Kai Pak Ling Road warehouse storing timber shortly after 1.15pm; 28 people were evacuated and no injuries were reported.

zh.headline: 流浮山木材貨倉三級火 28人疏散無人傷
zh.dek: 消防下午約1時15分接報雞伯嶺路鳳降村貨倉起火，1時29分升為三級，現場存放木材，需遠距離拖喉灌救。

en.headline: Cheung Kong Center II nearly fully leased after SIG takes three floors
en.dek: CK Hutchison said the 41-storey Central tower’s leasable space is almost fully taken, with US quant firm Susquehanna International Group signing for about 52,000 square feet.

zh.headline: 長江集團中心二期可租樓面接近全租 SIG租用三層
zh.dek: 長實表示中環長江集團中心二期可出租樓面已接近全部租出，美國量化交易公司Susquehanna International Group簽約租用約5.2萬平方呎。

en.headline: Major banks hold Hong Kong prime rates after HKMA base-rate rise
en.dek: HSBC, Bank of China (Hong Kong) and Standard Chartered left their best lending rates unchanged on Thursday despite the monetary authority lifting the Base Rate to 4.25 per cent.

zh.headline: 主要銀行維持港元最優惠利率不變
zh.dek: 金管局將基本利率上調至4.25厘後，匯豐、中銀香港及渣打均宣布維持港元最優惠利率不變。

en.headline: Hang Seng falls about 240 points after Federal Reserve hike
en.dek: Hong Kong stocks opened lower on Thursday as investors digested the first US rate increase since 2023 and the HKMA’s matching lift in the Base Rate.

zh.headline: 聯儲局加息後恒指早市下跌約240點
zh.dek: 港股周四早段低開，投資者消化美國三年來首次加息，以及金管局同步上調基本利率。

en.headline: Lee says Tenant Purchase Scheme still has problems to study
en.dek: On a radio phone-in, the Chief Executive said about 15 per cent of flats in the 39 estates remain unsold and asked the Housing Bureau to keep examining the plan.

zh.headline: 李家超：租置計劃仍有問題 房屋局繼續研究
zh.dek: 特首在電台節目表示，39個租置屋邨仍有約一成半單位未售出，已要求房屋局研究如何處理，包括未賣出單位。

en.headline: German film festival KINO/26 opens tonight in Sai Wan Ho
en.dek: The Goethe-Institut programme begins on 17 September with Fatih Akin’s Amrum at the Hong Kong Film Archive, and runs into early October at several cinemas.

zh.headline: 德國電影節KINO/26今晚西灣河揭幕
zh.dek: 歌德學院主辦的影展由9月17日起舉行，開幕片為法提阿金的《小島無戰事》，晚上7時於香港電影資料館放映。

en.headline: Cheung Wah Estate water supply restored after Fanling burst
en.dek: Drinking and flushing water began returning to normal from about 1.30am, the Water Supplies Department said, while San Wan Road traffic controls remain for repairs.

zh.headline: 粉嶺祥華邸供水凌晨起回復 新運路仍封路搶修
zh.dek: 水務署表示食水及沖廁水約凌晨1時半起陸續恢復正常，新運路因水管及路面下陷繼續實施交通管制。

en.headline: Police seek public help to find girl missing from Sau Mau Ping
en.dek: Officers appealed on Thursday for information on a 14-year-old who left an On Tai Estate flat on Saturday afternoon and has not been seen since.

zh.headline: 警方籲市民提供秀茂坪失蹤女童消息
zh.dek: 一名14歲女童上周六下午離開安泰邨住所後失蹤，家人周一報案，警方周四公開呼籲市民提供線索。

en.headline: Hang Seng slips about 240 points after Federal Reserve hike
en.dek: By mid-morning the index was near 24,473, down almost 1 per cent from Wednesday’s close, as investors weighed the first US rate rise since 2023.

zh.headline: 恒指早段跌約240點 市場消化美息上調
zh.dek: 周四上午近10時35分，恒生指數報24,473點，較周三收市跌近1%，投資者消化美國三年來首次加息。

en.headline: Lee Tung Avenue hangs more than 800 Mid-Autumn lanterns
en.dek: The Wan Chai pedestrian street's display runs until 19 October, with lights from 5pm and an 18-metre LED fire dragon parade on 25 September.

zh.headline: 灣仔利東街懸掛逾800盞中秋燈籠至10月
zh.dek: 「彩燈‧迎月」沿200米林蔭大道展出至10月19日，下午5時亮燈；9月25日將有18米LED火龍巡遊。

en.headline: Kitchee open AFC Champions League Two campaign at Mong Kok
en.dek: The Hong Kong champions host South Korea’s Gangwon FC at 8.15pm in Group H, with Kuching City and Phnom Penh Crown the other sides in the pool.

zh.headline: 傑志亞冠二級聯賽首戰今晚旺角迎戰江原FC
zh.dek: 港超冠軍晚上8時15分在旺角大球場揭開H組戰幕，同組還有古晉城及金邊皇冠。

en.headline: HKMA lifts base rate to 4.25pc, first rise since 2023
en.dek: The monetary authority followed the US Federal Reserve’s quarter-point increase, setting the Discount Window benchmark under the linked exchange rate formula.

zh.headline: 金管局將基本利率調高至4.25厘 2023年以來首次上調
zh.dek: 跟隨美國聯儲局加息四分一厘，金管局按聯繫匯率預設公式即時將貼現窗基準定於4.25厘。

en.headline: Wong Tai Sin temple opens Mid-Autumn lantern evenings from today
en.dek: Sik Sik Yuen's Pou Chai Heung Kong lantern programme runs from 17 September as part of the organisation's 105th anniversary and National Day events.

zh.headline: 嗇色園黃大仙祠中秋綵燈晚會今起舉行
zh.dek: 「普濟香江中秋綵燈晚會」周四起在黃大仙祠展開，屬嗇色園105周年及國慶系列活動，展出花燈及105盎山羊造型紀慶燈。

en.headline: Customs seizes HK$1.45m of drugs from two airport passengers
en.dek: Officers found suspected cannabis buds in a Bangkok arrival's carry-on bag and cocaine hidden in a Kuala Lumpur passenger's shoes; one man appears in court today.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢145萬元大麻花及可卡因 拘兩旅客
zh.dek: 海關連續兩日在機場檢獲約3.5公斤懸疑大麻花及1公斤懸疑可卡因；藏毒於鞋內的男子今在西九龍裁判法院提堂。

en.headline: Fanling water main burst cuts supply at Cheung Wah Estate
en.dek: A 200-millimetre fresh-water pipe near the estate entrance flooded San Wan Road on Wednesday night; the Water Supplies Department said service was restored from about 1.30am.

zh.headline: 粉嶺新運路食水管爆裂 祥華邸一度停水
zh.dek: 周三晚祥華邸入口附近一條直徑200毫米食水管爆裂，黃泥水湧上路面；水務署稱食水及沖廁水今晨約1時半起陸續恢復。

en.headline: Crew member dies after being trapped in Tuen Mun ship crevice
en.dek: A man of about 62 was freed unconscious after nearly two hours in a cabin gap off Ho Yeung Street and was certified dead at Tuen Mun Hospital.

zh.headline: 屯門船員墮船艙嬗隙被困近兩小時後不治
zh.dek: 約62歲男子清晨在浩洋街對開船上跌入船艙狹縫，消防近兩小時後救出時已昏迷，其後於屯門醫院證實死亡。

en.headline: Free unlimited tram rides on Hong Kong Island today
en.dek: UnionPay International is offering unlimited free travel on all Hong Kong Tramways services on Thursday as part of a promotion tied to its lucky draw campaign.

zh.headline: 今日港島電車全日免費任坐
zh.dek: 銀聯國際周四舉辦電車免費乘車日，市民及旅客可無限次免費乘搭港島電車，活動同時為其抽獎盛典揭幕。

en.headline: Police constable left vegetative after 2005 knife attack dies after 21 years
en.dek: Chu Chun-kwok, who was paralysed from the neck down after being slashed while on duty in Cheung Sha Wan, died at Kwong Wah Hospital on Wednesday aged 52.

zh.headline: 2005年執勤遇刺成植物人警員朱振國離世
zh.dek: 前警員朱振國2005年在深水埗執勤時遭刀割頸動脈，其後成為植物人21年，周三於廣華醫院離世，終年52歲。

en.headline: Police arrest husband after woman found dead with knife wounds in Heng Fa Chuen
en.dek: A 53-year-old woman was discovered with neck wounds in a flat in Block 2 of the Chai Wan estate late on Wednesday; her 52-year-old husband was arrested on suspicion of murder.

zh.headline: 杏花邨女子頸部刀傷倒斃 丈夫涉謀殺被捕
zh.dek: 周三晚柴灣杏花邨第二座單位內一名53歲女子頸部受傷倒斃，警方拘捕其52歲丈夫，案件列作謀殺，由東區重案組調查。

en.headline: CHP investigates two new Mpox cases; annual total reaches 23
en.dek: Two men, aged 48 and 30, are in stable condition under isolation after testing positive; both reported high-risk contact with other men in Hong Kong during the incubation period.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心調查兩宗猴痘確診個案 本年累計23宗
zh.dek: 兩名分別48歲及30歲男子情況穩定，正接受隔離治療；兩人潛伏期內均曾在港與其他男子有高風險接觸。

en.headline: Second-child baby bonus rises to HK$30,000 under 11 fertility measures
en.dek: The existing HK$20,000 newborn bonus is extended for three years, while tax allowance for second and subsequent children also increases, Chief Executive John Lee said.

zh.headline: 第二胎新生嬰兒獎勵金增至3萬元 生育措施共11項
zh.dek: 行政長官宣布現有2萬元新生嬰兒獎勵金計劃延長三年，第二名及之後子女獎勵金提高至3萬元，相關免稅額亦上調。

en.headline: Hong Kong to pilot foreign domestic carers for elderly care next year
en.dek: The scheme, modelled on the existing foreign domestic helper regime, will admit carers with advanced training and experience to meet home-care needs of older residents.

zh.headline: 港府明年試行輸入外籍家居照顧員照顧長者
zh.dek: 行政長官在施政報告中宣布，參照外傭制度試行輸入具備較高護老培訓及經驗的外籍家居照顧員，以滿足居家長者照顧需要。

en.headline: Lee pledges building maintenance reforms and bid-rigging study after Tai Po fire
en.dek: The chief executive said a legal study on criminalising bid-rigging in major works would go to LegCo this year, alongside pre-qualified contractor lists and stronger oversight.

zh.headline: 李家超承諾改革樓宇維修制度 研圍標刑事化
zh.dek: 行政長官在施政報告中表示，會就大維修圍標行為進行法律研究，今年內向立法會提交建議，並推出預審顧問承建商名單及招標評標服務。

en.headline: Hang Seng closes up 46 points as chip and AI shares advance
en.dek: The index ended at 24,713 after swinging lower earlier, with Lenovo rising more than 8 per cent and semiconductor names among the stronger performers.

zh.headline: 恒指收升46點 晶片及AI股造好
zh.dek: 恒生指數收報24,713點，升46點或0.19%，早段曾跌近100點後回升，聯想升逾8%，為當日表現最佳藍籌。

en.headline: High Court ends 1991 hold-up trial after defendant dies of cancer
en.dek: The jury was discharged on Wednesday after Wen Wenye, 62, died in custody earlier in the week while the special hearing into the Sham Shui Po shooting was under way.

zh.headline: 高等法院終止1991年深水埗劫殺案聆訊 被告病逝
zh.dek: 被告文穩業（62歲）早前因肺癌致認知障礙被裁定不適合答辯，本周在扣押期間昏迷後不治，法官周三解散陪審團。

en.headline: International Lantern Spectacular opens at Victoria Park from Thursday
en.dek: The Hong Kong Tourism Board’s inaugural free event runs 17 to 27 September, featuring lanterns from 20 countries and giant Nanjing Qinhuai works including an eight-metre banyan installation.

zh.headline: 國際中秋綵燈匯周四起在維園亮燈
zh.dek: 香港旅遊發展局首辦免費活動由9月17日至27日舉行，展出20個國家地區綵燈及南京秦淮巨型作品，包括八米高榕樹裝置。

en.headline: Hong Kong retains Asia’s top financial hub ranking for fourth straight year
en.dek: The city placed third globally in the latest Global Financial Centres Index, scoring 756 points, one behind London and one ahead of Singapore.

zh.headline: 香港連續第四度蟬聯亞洲金融中心榜首
zh.dek: 最新《全球金融中心指數》報告顯示，香港以756分位列全球第三，僅次於紐約及倫敦，並領先新加坡一分。

en.headline: High Court orders Wang Fuk Court renovation consultant into liquidation
en.dek: Will Power Architects Company Limited, the firm that advised the Tai Po estate’s major renovation before the November 2025 fire, failed to appear on a creditor’s petition and was wound up today.

zh.headline: 宏福苑維修顧問鴻毅被頒令清盤
zh.dek: 擔任大埔宏福苑強制驗樓工程顧問的鴻毅建築師有限公司，今日在高等法院因債權人呈請而被頒令清盤，公司無人應訊。

en.headline: Police seize HK$210,000 of drugs in Yau Ma Tei flat, arrest 11
en.dek: Yau Tsim officers raided a Man Ming Lane unit on Tuesday, recovering suspected methamphetamine, heroin, cocaine and midazolam tablets; a 56-year-old woman was held for operating a drug den.

zh.headline: 油麻地文明里毒窟檢值21萬毒品 拘11人
zh.dek: 油尖警方周二突擊搜查文明里單位，檢獲懷疑冰毒、海洛英、可卡因及藍精靈，56歲女子涉經營毒窟及販運被捕。

en.headline: WestK Picnic Fest opens on the Art Park lawn from Friday
en.dek: The West Kowloon Cultural District will run a harbourfront market, workshops and live music on selected dates from 18 September to 11 October, 2pm to 9pm.

zh.headline: 西九野餐節周五起在藝術公園海濰草坪舉行
zh.dek: 西九文化區宣布活動於9月18日至10月11日周末及假期舉行，一般下午2時至晚上9時，設市集、工作坊及現場表演。

en.headline: Lee delivers Hong Kong’s first five-year plan and Policy Address
en.dek: The chief executive began presenting both documents at the Legislative Council at 11am, after a two-month consultation that drew tens of thousands of submissions.

zh.headline: 李家超在立法會發表首份五年規劃及施政報告
zh.dek: 行政長官今早11時在立法會宣讀《香港首個五年規劃》及2026年《施政報告》，兩份文件合共逾十萬字。

en.headline: Tuen Mun Road crash snarls Kowloon-bound traffic at rush hour
en.dek: A private car and a goods vehicle collided near the Tsing Tin Interchange about 8am; local reports said no one was injured and closed lanes reopened after 9am.

zh.headline: 屯門公路平治撼貨車 出九龍車龍一度延至元朗
zh.dek: 今早約8時青田交匯處附近私家車與中型貨車相撞，運輸署指部分行車線曾封閉，報道指無人受傷，9時後逐步回復。

en.headline: Princess Margaret Hospital evacuates Block G after gas report
en.dek: The Hospital Authority said floors 12 to 14 of the Kwai Chung hospital’s pathology block were cleared around 9am; emergency services were not affected.

zh.headline: 瑪嘉烈醫院G座接不明氣體報告 病理樓三層疏散
zh.dek: 醫管局指今早約9時葵涌瑪嘉烈醫院G座12至14樓接報，屬病理部工作樓層，不涉病人服務，急症服務未受影響。

en.headline: Cheung Sha Wan menu archive show runs until 27 September
en.dek: After Taste, staged by studio artellex in an industrial building, displays historic menus, cookbooks and Mid-Autumn mooncake tins; entry is free by appointment.

zh.headline: 長沙灣《過去味來》展出百年餐牌 27日結束
zh.dek: 攝影工作室artellex在長順街工業大廈展出舊菜單、食譜及中秋月餅罐模，免費入場須預約，中秋前可看最後數天。

en.headline: Little Bao chef May Chow to cook at Regent Lobby Lounge in October
en.dek: The hotel says the month-long residency runs from 2 to 31 October at The Lobby Lounge on Salisbury Road, pairing bao and sharing plates with the harbour view.

zh.headline: 包點店Little Bao主廚周思薇月進駐香港麗晶酒店
zh.dek: 酒店宣布10月2日至31日於大堂酒廊與行政總廚Calvin Choi合作，以包點及分享小食重塑本地街頭味道，面向維港。

en.headline: Four face District Court trial over alleged Man Sang pump-and-dump
en.dek: Prosecutors say a Telegram account calling itself Edan Master steered buyers into Man Sang Metal Packaging shares before a coordinated sell-off; all four defendants deny the charge.

zh.headline: 萬成金屬包裝唱高散貨案開審 四人否認控罪
zh.dek: 控方指Telegram用戶「Edan師傅」誘使股民買入萬成股份，其後有組織帳戶同步拋售；四名被告否認意圖欺詐而串謀使用計劃罪。

en.headline: Police find no evidence after Tuen Mun report of planned dog killing
en.dek: Animal-welfare volunteers called officers after a resident said she overheard talk of slaughtering a red-collared dog in So Kwun Wat; a search of a village house found nothing.

zh.headline: 屯門掃管笏傳有人擬殺狗食用 警搜屋後無發現
zh.dek: 動物團體接報指村內有人揚言宰殺戴紅頸帶狗隻，義工聞狗吤報案；警方進入村屋調查，未發現殺狗或食狗證據，列雜項處理。

en.headline: Girl, 17, arrested after mother reports suspected drug use in Yau Tong
en.dek: Police seized three suspected etomidate vape pods at a Yau Lai Estate flat after a late-night call on Tuesday; the teenager was held for alleged possession of dangerous drugs.

zh.headline: 油塘油麗邨17歲少女涉藏依托咪酯煙彈被捕
zh.dek: 母親周二深夜報案指女兒在家吸毒，警方在雅麗樓單位檢獲三粒懷疑依托咪酯煙彈，少女涉嫌管有危險藥物扣查。

en.headline: M+ opens Herzog & de Meuron focus display of China projects
en.dek: Models, drawings and material samples from the Swiss firm that designed the museum, including Tai Kwun and Beijing’s National Stadium, are on view in the Focus Gallery from 12 September.

zh.headline: M+展出赫爾佐格與德梅隆中國項目模型及圖則
zh.dek: 設計本館的瑞士事務所損贈模型、繪圖及物料樣本，包括大館及北京國家體育場，9月12日起於焦點空間展出。

en.headline: Reportable police complaints fall 5pc, but assault claims rise
en.dek: IPCC figures for the first eight months show 1,353 reportable complaints, while serious allegations rose 44 per cent to 95, including 90 of assault.

zh.headline: 首八個月須匯報投訴警隊個案跌5% 毀打指控升67%
zh.dek: 監警會公布1,353宗須匯報投訴，較去年同期少；性質嚴重指控95項，其中毀打90項，多數源自拘捕行動。

en.headline: Motorcyclist, 21, dies after crash on Tai Au Mun Road
en.dek: The rider lost control on a left bend near Clear Water Bay First Beach just after midnight and struck a stone barrier; he was certified dead at Tseung Kwan O Hospital.

zh.headline: 清水灣大坳門路電單車撞石壘 21歲鐵騎士不治
zh.dek: 凌晨近1時電單車在清水灣第一灣對開左彎失控，騎士昏迷送將軍澳醫院後不治，警方正調查起因。

en.headline: Three firefighters hurt after pump part flies off at Tseung Kwan O plant
en.dek: A component detached while crews were cooling an overheated pump that had sent up steam at the desalination plant on Tuesday night; all three remained conscious.

zh.headline: 將軍澳化淡廠水泵機件飛脫 三名消防員受傷送院
zh.dek: 周二晚環保大道海水化淡廠水泵過熱冒蒸汽，消防開喉降溫期間機件飛脫，三人清醒送院。

en.headline: Tung Chee-hwa state funeral set for North Point this weekend
en.dek: A vigil will be held on Saturday afternoon at the Hong Kong Funeral Home, with a public memorial and procession on Sunday morning, under an 87-member funeral committee.

zh.headline: 董建華國葬周末在北角舉行 周六設靈周日公祭
zh.dek: 設靈周六下午在香港殮儀館福海堂，周日早上公祭及出殮；治喪委員會由全國政協第一副主席石泰峰擔任主任。

en.headline: Kai Tak Sports Park main stadium launches Asian Games light show from tonight
en.dek: A 30-minute dynamic display on the main stadium façade runs nightly from 8pm until 24 October, featuring cheer messages and visual motifs of Olympic sports including e-sports.

zh.headline: 啟德體育園主場館外牆今晚起上演亞運主題燈光展
zh.dek: 每晚8時至8時半，展至10月24日，展示「全城上下撐港隊」訊息及乒乓球、單車、劍擊、足球、電競等動感畫面。

en.headline: Fire Services seize 921 litres of petrol from illegal station in Tsz Lok Estate car park
en.dek: A 34-year-old two-way permit holder was intercepted after officers found a seven-seater van leaking fuel and fitted with a tank and refuelling tools; enough petrol for about 20 private cars was recovered.

zh.headline: 消防搗破慈樂邨停車場非法加油站 檢921公升汽油截查雙程證男
zh.dek: 一輛七人車漏油，車內發現油缸及入油工具，檢獲足以注滿約20輛私家車的汽油；34歲持雙程證男子涉嫌多項危險品及消防條例罪行。

en.headline: AFCD signs contract for urban farming pilot at Laguna Park in Kwun Tong
en.dek: A 500-square-metre indoor hydroponic farm is scheduled to open in 2027, offering local produce and public farming activities.

zh.headline: 漁護署與青協簽約 觀塘麗港公園設都市農耕先導項目
zh.dek: 約500平方米室內水耕農場預計2027年運作，提供本地蔬菜及公眾體驗活動。

en.headline: SAIC-GM-Wuling unveils six-seat Darion electric taxi for Hong Kong
en.dek: The model offers a claimed 540 km range and is priced around HK$300,000; first deliveries are expected next month.

zh.headline: 上汽通用五菱推出六座Darion純電的士 售約30萬元
zh.dek: 官方續航540公里，即日起接受預訂，首批預計10月交付。

en.headline: Space Museum launches Wild Asia dome show from Wednesday
en.dek: The 43-minute presentation runs until June 2027 and follows wildlife surviving in the Himalayas, Gobi Desert and Pacific depths.

zh.headline: 太空館周三起放映球幕電影《極境亞洲之生命奇跡》
zh.dek: 43分鐘影片展至2027年6月，帶領觀眾認識喜馬拉雅、戈壁及深海中的野生動物求生故事。

en.headline: Man and woman found dead in car near Chi Ma Wan Correctional Institution
en.dek: Police say traces consistent with charcoal burning were found inside the vehicle on a slope opposite the institution; the pair are understood to have been a couple.

zh.headline: 芝麻灣懲教所對開斜坡發現男女車內遺體
zh.dek: 警方在車內發現燒過的炭及金屬盆，兩人據悉為情侶；死因有待調查。

en.headline: CUHK journalism school website redirected to gambling page; university suspends site
en.dek: Visitors to the School of Journalism and Communication site were sent to a newly registered domain; the university says no personal data leakage has been found so far.

zh.headline: 中大新傳學院網站被導向博彩頁 校方暫停網站調查
zh.dek: 訪客瀏覽新聞與傳播學院網站時被重新導向至新註冊域名；校方表示暫未發現個人敏感資料外洩。

en.headline: LCSD sets up Asian Games focal sites across 18 districts
en.dek: Sports centres will broadcast live coverage from 19 September to 4 October so the public can watch and cheer for national and Hong Kong athletes.

zh.headline: 康文署18區設亞運觀賞站 鼓勵市民為運動員打氣
zh.dek: 指定體育館將於9月19日至10月4日直播亞運會賽事，公眾可到場觀看並為國家及香港運動員加油。

en.headline: Reported drug abusers fall 9pc in first half of 2026
en.dek: Central Registry figures show 2,688 reported abusers, down from 2,955 a year earlier; youth under 21 also declined while etomidate remains the main drug among young people.

zh.headline: 上半年被呈報吸毒人數跌9% 青少年組別亦下降
zh.dek: 檔案室數字顯示上半年2,688人被呈報，按年減少，21歲以下由458人降至404人，依托咪酯仍是青少年最常吸食毒品。

en.headline: CHP investigates new Mpox case involving 27-year-old man
en.dek: The patient developed genital rash and fever; he is stable in isolation at Queen Elizabeth Hospital after high-risk contact with two male strangers in Hong Kong.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心調查新一宗猴痘個案 27歲男患者情況穩定
zh.dek: 患者生殖器官起疹發燒，潛伏期內曾與兩名陌生男子有高風險接觸，現於伊利沙伯醫院隔離治療。

en.headline: Employers’ hiring outlook rebounds to +14pc for fourth quarter
en.dek: ManpowerGroup’s latest survey of 603 Hong Kong employers shows net employment sentiment swung from minus 9 per cent last quarter to plus 14 per cent, with information technology the strongest sector.

zh.headline: 第四季就業展望指數回升至正14% 資訊業最樂觀
zh.dek: 萬寶盛華調查603名僱主，季節性調整後就業展望指數由上季負9%升至正14%，三成計劃增聘，資訊科技業指數最高達27%。

en.headline: Salt-water main bursts on Kwun Tong Road, slow lane closed for repair
en.dek: A 150-millimetre salt-water pipe supplying flushing water to Yue Man Centre ruptured near Hip Wo Path about 1pm, sending a two-metre jet of water onto the pavement and one lane before crews shut the valve.

zh.headline: 觀塘道鹹水管爆裂噴兩米水柱 慢線一度封閉搶修
zh.dek: 今日下午約1時觀塘道近馬蹄徑一段直徑150毫米鹹水供水管爆裂，水柱高近兩米，影響行人路及一條行車線；水務署關掣後已停止湧水，慢線其後重開。

en.headline: Police recover HK$1m jewellery stolen from airport hotel lobby
en.dek: A Sri Lankan exhibitor reported the theft of gemstones while resting in a hotel near the airport on Sunday; officers arrested a 32-year-old man in Tsing Yi the same evening and recovered the items.

zh.headline: 機場酒店大堂失近百萬珠寶原石 警6小時拘人起回
zh.dek: 斯里蘭卡參展商周日在機場附近酒店休息時失竊，機場警區翻查閉路電視後同日晚在青衣酒店拘捕32歲男子並起回全部原石。

en.headline: Victoria Park Mid-Autumn Lantern Carnival opens Thursday
en.dek: The free display organised by the Leisure and Cultural Services Department runs from 17 to 27 September, featuring Hong Kong-themed lanterns and a large banyan-tree installation by the Tourism Board.

zh.headline: 維園中秋綵燈會周四起舉行至27日
zh.dek: 康文署主辦的免費綵燈展以香港特色為題，旅發局呈獻八米榕樹裝置「影光」，亮燈時間傍晚6時半至11時。

en.headline: Two brothers found dead in Lei Tung Estate flat; no foul play suspected
en.dek: Police say the bodies of men aged 55 and 53 were discovered after a security guard reported a foul smell; post-mortems are pending and the case is treated as discovery of bodies.

zh.headline: 利東邨單位發現兩兄弟遺體 初步無疑點
zh.dek: 東業樓保安周一報單位傳異味，警消破門發現55歲及53歲兄弟已死，案件列屍體發現，死因有待驗屍。

en.headline: MTR sets 24 October as Thank You Day with half-price rides
en.dek: Octopus, JoyYou Card and QR-code journeys on heavy rail, Light Rail and selected MTR buses will be half-price, including Lo Wu and Lok Ma Chau cross-boundary trips.

zh.headline: 港鐵10月24日設感謝日 八達通乘車半價
zh.dek: 當日使用八達通、樂悠咭或二維碼乘搭港鐵、輕鐵及指定巴士可享半價，包括羅湖及落馬洲過境車程。

en.headline: Wang Fuk Court owners’ special sales scheme balloting sets selection order
en.dek: Computer random draw results for the first batch were released this morning; full results will be posted on the scheme website around 3pm.

zh.headline: 宏福苑特設銷售計劃攪珠 定出業主揀樓次序
zh.dek: 上午進行電腦隨機排序，第一批頭十個申請編號尾數為25、28、75等，完整結果約下午3時上載網站。

en.headline: August visitor arrivals hit 5.46 million, post-pandemic monthly high
en.dek: The Tourism Board said provisional figures rose 6 per cent year on year, lifting the first-eight-month total to about 36.67 million, up 11 per cent.

zh.headline: 8月訪港旅客546萬人次創疫後單月新高
zh.dek: 旅發局公布初步數字按年升6%，首八個月累計約3,667萬人次，按年升11%。

en.headline: Dunhuang mural panels open at Yuen Long Theatre from today
en.dek: A free LCSD touring display of Sui and Tang scenes copied from cave murals runs at the theatre until 29 September before moving to Central Library.

zh.headline: 敦煌石窟壁畫巡展今起在元朗劇院展出至月底
zh.dek: 康文署與弘揚中華文化辦公室、敦煌研究院合辦的免費巡迴展覽，以圖板重現隋唐生活場景，其後轉往中央圖書館。

en.headline: Man, 29, arrested after alleged street assault in Shau Kei Wan
en.dek: Police say a woman reported being grabbed around the neck and indecently assaulted in Nam On Lane just after 1am; she did not need hospital treatment.

zh.headline: 箏箕灣南安里女子報稱遭箍頸非禮 警拘29歲男子
zh.dek: 警方指凌晨1時05分接獲34歲女子報案，指在南安里被男子箍頸後懷疑被觸碰胸部，事主毋須送院。

en.headline: Lee says government will crack down on forced shopping in Golden Week
en.dek: Cross-department meetings, a Security Bureau incident centre and extra staff at popular sites are planned for the National Day holiday rush.

zh.headline: 李家超：國慶黃金周嚴打強迫購物 跨部門統籌口岸及景點
zh.dek: 特首指政務司司長及文體旅局將開跨部門會議，保安局黃金周會啟動緊急事故監察及支援中心，旅發局亦設網上專頁。

en.headline: Lee shows blue Five-Year Plan cover ahead of Wednesday release
en.dek: Hong Kong's first Five-Year Plan and the 2026 Policy Address will be issued together on 16 September, with a two-volume summary prepared for the public.

zh.headline: 李家超展示五年規劃藍色封面 施政報告周三一併發表
zh.dek: 特首指《香港第一個五年規劃》封面用藍色，代表開放、進步和穩重；施政報告沿用綠色，兩份文件全文合共約十萬字。

en.headline: Lee orders one-month probe into Queen Mary Hospital lift faults
en.dek: The chief executive said contractors, subcontractors and, if involved, government staff would be held to account after lifts in the new clinical block failed to work properly.

zh.headline: 李家超下令一個月內查清瑪麗醫院新樓升降機問題
zh.dek: 特首出席行政會議前表示，必須盡快糾正新臨床大樓升降機未能有效運作的問題，並追究承建商、分判商及如涉及的政府人員責任。

en.headline: Cultural Centre piazza to show Mid-Autumn lights from Thursday
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department will light a free Mid-Autumn installation at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre from 17 September to 11 October.

zh.headline: 文化中心露天廣場中秋光影裝置周四起亮燈
zh.dek: 康文署社區節目辦事處將於9月17日至10月11日在香港文化中心露天廣場展出中秋光影裝置，免費入場。

en.headline: Seasonal flu vaccination programme starts on Thursday
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection said the 2026/27 schemes open on 17 September, offering free or subsidised jabs while influenza activity remains high.

zh.headline: 季節性流感疫苗接種計劃周四展開
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心表示，2026／27年度計劃將於9月17日展開，合資格人士可免費或獲資助接種，本港流感活躍程度仍處高水平。

en.headline: Police seek domestic helper after HK$206,000 Deep Water Bay theft
en.dek: A resident reported two watches, a tablet and cash missing from a Shouson Hill Road flat on Monday afternoon; no arrest has been made.

zh.headline: 深水灣單位失約20.6萬元財物 警追緙外傭
zh.dek: 壽山村道一個單位周一午后報失兩隻手錶、平板電腦及現金，案件列盜竊，暫未有人被捕。

en.headline: Observatory extends Thunderstorm Warning until 9.30am
en.dek: Isolated thunderstorms are expected over the New Territories after the warning issued at 4.42am was prolonged this morning.

zh.headline: 天文台將雷暴警告延長至上午9時30分
zh.dek: 今早4時42分發出的雷暴警告已延長至上午9時30分，預料新界有局部地區雷暴。

en.headline: Yuen Long market lane hangs handmade lanterns ahead of Mid-Autumn
en.dek: The incense shop Koon Heung Hong again lines a passage inside Tai Kiu Market with hand-tied lanterns in the weeks before the festival on 25 September.

zh.headline: 中秋將至 元朗大橋街市再掛手紮燈籠
zh.dek: 大橋街市內香燭店冠香行按年在巷內掛起手紮燈籠，中秋正日為9月25日，翌日為公眾假期。

en.headline: Man, 66, arrested over HK$210,000 of drugs at Chuk Yuen South
en.dek: Police seized suspected cocaine and ice from a man and a flat at Sau Yuen House; he is due in Kowloon City Magistrates' Courts on Wednesday.

zh.headline: 竹園南部檢值21萬毒品 66歲男子涉販毒被捕
zh.dek: 秀茂坪警區人員周一晚在秀園樓外及單位內檢獲懸疑可卡因及冰毒，案件周三早上在九龍城裁判法院提堂。

en.headline: Two men arrested in Mong Kok anti-drug operations
en.dek: Police say a commercial unit on Dundas Street was used as a drug den and a street stop later yielded suspected drugs worth about HK$13,000.

zh.headline: 旺角商廈單位涉毒窟 警拘兩男檢1.3萬元毒品
zh.dek: 旺角反三合會行動組周一展開「明法」行動，在登打士街商廈拘捕39歲男子；同日在街上截查再拘51歲男子。

en.headline: Sha Tin driver arrested after crash and false robbery report
en.dek: Police say a 37-year-old man crashed into a barrier at Lung Hang Estate, fled, then claimed he had been robbed; officers found suspected drugs in the car.

zh.headline: 沙田隆亨部私家車撞閘 司機報假劫案兼藏毒被捕
zh.dek: 警方指37歲男子在榮心樓外撞欄後逃走，其後報稱遭3人行劫，調查後認為與事實不符，並在車內檢獲懸疑毒品。

en.headline: Observatory issues Thunderstorm Warning until 7.30am
en.dek: The warning was issued at 4.42am after overnight thunderstorms; isolated storms are still expected at first before a hot, partly sunny day.

zh.headline: 天文台清晨再發雷暴警告 有效至上午7時30分
zh.dek: 天文台周二上午4時42分發出雷暴警告，有效至7時30分，預料本港初時仍有局部地區雷暴。

en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning extended until midnight Tuesday
en.dek: The Observatory prolonged the warning first issued at 6.30pm Monday, saying isolated thunderstorms are still expected over Hong Kong.

zh.headline: 雷暴警告延長至周二午夜
zh.dek: 天文台周一傍晚6時30分發出的雷暴警告延長有效至周二午夜12時，預料本港仍有局部地區雷暴。

en.headline: Smoke from container office at Prince of Wales Hospital redevelopment site; no injuries
en.dek: Firefighters raised the alarm to No. 2 after thick smoke was reported from a worksite container office in Sha Tin around 9.47pm; the blaze was under control within half an hour.

zh.headline: 威爾斯親王醫院重建地盤貨櫃辦公室冒濃煙 無人受傷
zh.dek: 周一晚約9時47分沙田威院重建地盤有濃煙冒出，消防由一級改列二級火警，出動煙帽隊開喉灌救，約半小時後停止動員，初步無人受傷。

en.headline: Wong Tai Sin Hospital flu cluster grows by 14 cases; three elderly men die
en.dek: Hospital Authority says six more male patients in the chest ward, seven female patients in the convalescent ward and one staff member tested positive for influenza A; three men aged 81 to 95 with serious underlying…

zh.headline: 黃大仙醫院甲流群組再增14人 3名有嚴重疾病男病人離世
zh.dek: 醫管局指胸肺科病房再有6名男病人、療養病房7名女病人及1名職員確診甲型流感，其中3名81至95歲男病人因嚴重自身疾病離世，其餘情況穩定。

en.headline: Man arrested over alleged HK$2.84 million school placement scam
en.dek: Police say a 51-year-old businessman claimed he could secure places at a North Point secondary school and later university entry for dozens of students.

zh.headline: 訛稱提供學額保送大學 男子涉騙284萬元機場被捕
zh.dek: 警方指51歲商人聲稱可提供蘇浙公學學額及保證入讀港澳大學，收受內地升學顧問約284萬元。

en.headline: 17-year-old boy in intensive care with influenza A and septic shock
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection recorded a severe paediatric case; the patient is stable after treatment and the centre urges vaccination as the new programme starts on Thursday.

zh.headline: 17歲少年甲型流感併發敗血性休克 深切治療部留醫
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心錄得一宗兒童嚴重流感個案，患者情況已轉趨穩定；中心呼籲周四起盡快接種季節性流感疫苗。
